title: ConditionalOnlyPropertyAnyOf
description: The other applicator that contributes a property conditionally, kept beside conditional_only_property_positions.json as the line issue #213 stopped at. An anyOf variant's `properties` are merged into the struct exactly as a `then`'s are, and the field asserts them of every document exactly as it did there -- but nothing stands in for the field here: extractObjectAnyOfDefs decides which variant matched from its required keys and its consts, and never applies a variant's property schemas at all. So the narrowing is not taken, the field goes on over-enforcing, and the rows below say which of those two facts each document is measuring.
